columns.label: Athlete
columns.meaning: Invented unique athlete ID. One row is one athlete, not one jump.

columns.label: Session 1
columns.meaning: Mean height of 3 valid hands-on-hips CMJs; force-plate impulse-momentum calculation.

columns.label: Session 2
columns.meaning: Same summary, device, software and protocol at the second session.

columns.label: Protocol
columns.meaning: Both sessions use the same familiarized procedure, warm-up and trial aggregation.

columns.label: Separation
columns.meaning: Sessions are 7 days apart in a fictional stable period. This is a study-design choice, not a universal recovery prescription.

cleaningRules: Keep all 24 complete athlete pairs; there are no duplicate IDs or missing measurements in this dataset.
Do not treat the 3 jumps behind each session mean as 3 independent athlete pairs.
Calculate each signed difference as test2_cm − test1_cm. Use the sample SD of the 24 differences.
Report the mean bias separately. Centering for the SD does not prove the source of bias or justify silently correcting future results.
provenance: Entirely synthetic teaching data authored for this hub. Athlete IDs, dates, values, logs and scenarios are invented; no club or patient records were used. Values are for analysis practice, not validated injury-risk, readiness or clearance thresholds.
